findings.what: The labels 'Example 9.2' and 'Solution' are set in plain black roman type; the book sets both in blue underlined display script, which is what marks the box as a worked example. The blue tab bar down the left of the box is kept but faint.

note: Compared method 5 (Gabriel phthalimide synthesis) with its two-row scheme, method 6 (Hoffmann bromamide degradation) with its equation, and the Example 9.2 box. The Gabriel scheme is complete - both rows, phthalimide / N-alkylphthalimide labels, the KOH, R-X and NaOH(aq) arrow reagents, the ONa+ product and the '(1 deg amine)' note - and the Hoffmann equation is complete with its Br2 in green and NH2 in magenta, though both are set smaller than the book and enclosed in added frames. All prose of methods 5 and 6 is present and in order. The loss is confined to the Example 9.2 solution; the blank lower half of the page follows from it.
